children: Beazer Homes executed supplemental indentures for its 7.500% Senior Notes due 2031 and 8.000% Senior Notes due 2032, revising the Change of Control definition so the pending merger with Dream Finders will not trigger Change-of-Control provisions. The amendments became effective upon signing on September 18, 2026 and will become operative upon payment of consent fees, expected at merger closing. Regions Bank acted as trustee after Beazer secured the requisite noteholder consents via Dream Finders' consent solicitation.
